Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS: 7033 -1973 

Indian Standard 

COMMERCIAL MOISTURE REGAIN A^LUES 
FOR WOOL AND ITS PRODUCTS 

0. FOREWORD 

0.1 This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards 
Institution on 18 October 1973, after the draft finalized by the Wool 
and Wool Products Sectional Committee had been approved by the 
Textile Division Council. 

0.2 Wool is a highly hygroscopic fibre. Hence, the weight of a consign- 
ment of wool or its products changes depending upon the atmospheric 
conditions and the environments, which lead to ambiguities. The need 
for fixing commercial moisture regain values for wool and its products 
has, therefore, been keenly felt by the industry and trade to overcome 
such ambiguities. 

0.3 The commercial moisture regain values as recommended in the 
standard are not experimentally determined quantities but purely arbit- 
rary values arrived at for commercial purposes. The actual moisture 
regaiti values of wool and its products, when in moisture equihbrium 
with the standard atmosphere for testing, bear no consistent relation to 
the commercial moisture regain values specified in the standard. 
Equilibrium moisture regain value depends upon the previous history 
of the material. 

0.4 For determining correct invoice weight of woollen and worsted yarn, 
the method specified in IS : 4902-1968* shall be followed. 



1. SCOPE 

1.1 This standard recommends the commercial moisture regain values for 
wool and its pi^oducts. 

2. TERMINOLOGY 

2.1 Commercial Moisture Regain — An arbitrary value formally 

*Method for determination of correct invoice weight and moisture content of 
woollen and worsted yarns. 



18:7033-1973 



adopted as the regain to be used with the oven-dry weight when 
calculating: 

a) linean density of wool yarn, 

b) commercial or legal weight of a shipment or delivery of wool and 
its products, or 

c) the weight of wool in the analysis of fibre blends. 
3* RECOMMENDED MOISTURE REGAIN VALUES 

3.1 The commercial moisture regain values for wool and its products are 
recommended as given below:

Dry-combed

Dry-combed 
Scoured and carbonized
